_units.downtime_cost_per_min: currency per minute of unplanned line downtime
_units.downtime_minutes_avoided_per_flag: minutes of downtime avoided per confident bottleneck flag acted on
_units.avg_units_that_would_carry_it: units that would have carried the defect before it was noticed
_units.defect_caught_value: currency value of catching one chained defect before it propagates
_units.inspection_cost_per_check: currency cost of raising and performing one inspection
_units.false_alarm_cost: currency cost of acting on a low-confidence / abstained call
_units.vehicles_per_shift: vehicles produced per shift (drives extrapolation only)
_units.shifts_per_day: shifts per production day (drives extrapolation only)
